Outsourcing | services = IT/ ITES | revenue = {{INRConvert|814|c|nolink=yes}} (2024) | website = {{URL|3i-infotech.com}} }} '''3i Infotech Ltd''' is an Indian [[technology company]], headquartered in [[Navi Mumbai]], [[India]]. Established in 1993, the company provides IT services such as [[digital transformation]], [[cloud services]], [[cybersecurity]], and [[Application software|application development]] across sectors including banking, healthcare, government, telecommunications, and education.{{Cite web |date=2020-05-06 |title=UAE real estate developer signs on 3i Infotech for digital transformation |url=https://www.techcircle.in/2020/05/06/uae-real-estate-developer-signs-on-3i-infotech-for-digital-transformation |access-date=2025-04-12 |website=Techcircle |language=en}} == History == Established in 1993 as ICICI Infotech Ltd., 3i Infotech was a wholly owned subsidiary of ICICI/[[ICICI Bank]] until [[ICICI Bank|ICICI]] divested the majority of the shares in March 2002, at which point the company ceased to be a subsidiary of ICICI. Demerging from ICICI, the company embraced a wider range of industries, encompassing telecom, retail, manufacturing, and more.{{cite web |date=9 May 2007 |title=3i Infotech limited [3IINFOs] History |url=http://www.source2update.com/Company-History/3i-Infotech-3IINFO.html |access-date=2010-07-16 |publisher=Source2update.com}} ==Offices== {| class="wikitable" |- !!!
